si_4_title: Towards Longitudinal Characterization of Multiple Sclerosis Atrophy Employing SynthSeg Framework and Normative Modeling

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: MSSEG2016 (N=53); OpenMSLong (N=20); CHUV (N=41); NIL (N=47); INsIDER (N=165); CentileBrain (N=37,407 HC)
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: We analyzed a heterogeneous dataset comprising 326 MS patients from five sources: three in-house datasets (Lausanne University Hospital (CHUV), Louvain Neuroinflammation Imaging Lab (NIL), and Imaging Axonal Damage & Repair in Multiple Sclerosis (INsIDER) [ 20]) and two public datasets (MICCAI MSSEG2016 challenge [ 8] and OpenMSLong [ 30]). ... recently, the CentileBrain [ 18] model trained with 37,407 healthy individuals (53.3% females, age range 3-90) from 81 datasets has been released.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: Gordaliza2024.pdf.md: Section 2.1 / Materials, Paragraph 1; Section 2.2 / Methods / Normative Modeling, Paragraph 1

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: The MS datasets (MSSEG2016, OpenMSLong, CHUV, NIL, INsIDER) were used to evaluate deviations from the normative model. The CentileBrain model (pre-trained on 37,407 healthy individuals) provided the normative reference.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: By comparing subcortical volumes of 326 MS patients to a normative model from 37,407 healthy individuals, we identify significant deviations that enhance our understanding of MS progression. ... The CentileBrain [ 18] model trained with 37,407 healthy individuals ... has been released. The CentileBrain employs Multivariate Factorial Polynomial Regression (MFPR) [ 38] algorithm ... generating sex-specific normative models
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Gordaliza2024.pdf.md: Abstract; Section 2.2 / Methods / Normative Modeling, Paragraph 1
